edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender directly to the owner state variable.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner without any validation.
acceptOwnership uses msg.sender to gate and promote newOwner to owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller supplied identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using untrusted msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before any external interaction.
msg.sender controlled allowance state write precedes the external call.
Attacker supplied spender parameter determines the address of the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callee.
tokenAddress parameter is used as the callee of the external transfer call.
Recipient parameter of transfer is credited in the balances mapping.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom is credited in the balances mapping.
tokens parameter flows into safeSub when debiting sender balance.
tokens parameter flows into safeSub in transferFrom.
_totalSupply feeds the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] feeds the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
onlyOwner compares untrusted msg.sender against the owner state variable.
Re-entrant callback can invoke transfer and modify the balances mapping while approveAndCall is executing.
Re-entrant callback can invoke approve and modify the allowed mapping while approveAndCall is executing.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after the allowance state write.
State is written before the external call, exposing the classic reentrancy ordering.
transferAnyERC20Token triggers the external ERC20 transfer call.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
transfer relies on safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer relies on safeSub to debit the sender.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom relies on safeSub to debit balance and allowance.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before transferring ownership.
Owned constructor reads the untrusted msg.sender to initialize owner.
GoldBlocksTickets constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
GoldBlocksTickets constructor mints the initial supply into the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
The untrusted external callee can call back into the contract, including approveAndCall itself.
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token may call back into this contract.
